events.failure_summary: After the LMRP was disconnected for weather, the riser and LMRP separated. Five droop hoses temporarily retained the riser before failing.
events.damage: IADC reported no damage to subsea assets.

events.failure_summary: Gas escaped during casing cutting for permanent well abandonment. Havtil identified failed well barriers and issued an order.
A logging tool swung during crane transfer and struck a deck worker. Havtil identified deficiencies in lifting preparation, competence and follow-up.

equipment: riser spider and riser catwalk machine
events.failure_summary: During dismantling of riser-handling equipment, movement of the catwalk machine trapped a worker against the riser spider. Havtil identified procedural and equipment-control deficiencies.

During slip-joint extension before diverter installation, an incompletely secured tensioner ring disengaged. The unsupported riser damaged the LMRP, riser and other equipment. BSEE identified incomplete locking and inadequate verification instructions.

After well completion, a BOP lifted clear of the wellhead dropped, struck the wellhead and separated from its riser adapter onto the seabed. BSEE identified incorrect landing-assist-tool engagement and procedural deviation during rig movement.
